newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Deals to be announced at Abu Dhabi arms show.
newsitem.headline: Deals to be announced at Abu Dhabi arms show.

text.p: The oil-rich United Arab Emirates, a key buyer on the international weapons market, will announce several deals at an arms show in March, an official said in remarks published on Sunday.

"Surely, we always seek to upgrade our armed forces and we will announce during IDEX 97 a number of deals currently being studied for land and sea equipment," Sheikh Mohammad bin Zaid, armed forces chief of staff, told Gulf Defence magazine.
His comments were carried by the official WAM news agency.
Western firms are competing to sell the UAE up to 80 long-range strike aircraft worth up to $6 billion.
Sheikh Mohammad, the UAE' leading arms procurement officer, said 700 companies from over 45 countries were expected to attend IDEX, to be held in the capital Abu Dhabi between March 16 and 19.
He added that regional decision makers would attend the event and that official invitations had been extended to over 50 defence ministers from around the world.
The UAE has emerged as a key player in the international arms bazaar and has spent vast petrodollars on everything from main battle tanks to fast patrol boats.
